scope: This map separates mechanically enforced controls from pre-tool hooks, release-gated evidence, operator decisions, and prompt guidance across the Laravel Guild engineering loop.

levels.runtime: A state machine or command rejects the operation before accepting the transition.
levels.pre-tool-hook: An installed host hook rejects a covered tool call before the tool executes.
levels.ci: A named job required by immutable release publication tests or validates the control.
levels.operator: A human decision or external observation is authoritative and must be recorded; software validates the record but cannot make the decision.
levels.prompt: Generated agent instructions describe the procedure; this level guides behavior but is not a security boundary by itself.

globalLimitations: No repository control protects against arbitrary code executing as the same operating-system account and deliberately rewriting code, state, and evidence together.
Pre-tool hooks cover the tools and hosts that install them; unsupported runtimes must call the kernel explicitly and provide complete telemetry.
CI proves the committed fixtures and named invariants, not every application-specific behavior or production environment.
Human approvals, interruption confirmation, manual speed checks, and merge decisions remain operator judgments; the harness preserves and validates their durable records.

controls.title: Shared and role-specific harness policy
controls.guarantee: Every registered agent has one complete policy profile, and read-only roles align with tool denial while only the coordinator receives delegation authority.
controls.failureMode: Reject an unknown, incomplete, or contradictory profile before release or planned execution.
controls.operatorAction: Choose the registered specialist whose authority matches the requested work; do not widen a profile inside a task.
controls.limitation: Direct shell access outside installed hooks is not converted into an operating-system sandbox by this profile.

controls.title: Claimed path ownership
controls.guarantee: A mutation-capable stage declares project-relative owned paths, claims them atomically, and cannot report outputs outside them.
controls.failureMode: Deny the claim, native write, or stage report without accepting an out-of-scope output.
controls.operatorAction: Split overlapping work into non-overlapping stages or change the approved plan before dispatch.
controls.limitation: The native-write hook covers Write, Edit, and NotebookEdit; Bash mutation safety also depends on the installed command guardrails.

controls.title: Durable protected-action approval
controls.guarantee: A stage with a declared protected category cannot be claimed until the main thread records a user grant for that exact category.
controls.failureMode: Keep the stage queued and reject claim or mutation until the approval exists.
controls.operatorAction: Approve or decline the exact requested category after reviewing its scope and risk.
controls.limitation: The system validates declared categories; it cannot detect a planner that omitted a material protected category from the plan.

controls.title: Criterion-linked verification
controls.guarantee: Every success criterion has a stable ID and must have passing registered-runner evidence or a durable user waiver before completion.
controls.failureMode: Reject the report and leave the stage nonterminal when evidence coverage is missing or untrusted.
controls.operatorAction: Supply the missing check or explicitly accept the exact gap through a user-authored waiver.
controls.limitation: A passing registered command proves only what that command actually tests; semantic test quality remains a review concern.

controls.title: Typed human checkpoints
controls.guarantee: Questions raised after dispatch pause the affected lane with typed options, and only a recorded user choice can continue or stop it.
controls.failureMode: Keep the affected stage paused and exclude it from ready work until a valid resolution exists.
controls.operatorAction: Select one presented option after reviewing the persisted question, risk, and recommendation.
controls.limitation: The harness preserves the choice but cannot decide whether the human's risk judgment was correct.

controls.title: Measured stage budgets
controls.guarantee: Time and tool calls are checked before tool execution, completion telemetry supplies turns, tokens, and cost, and a breach becomes terminal.
controls.failureMode: Set stage and delivery to budget_exceeded, deny further dispatch, and reject a success report.
controls.operatorAction: Start a newly approved delivery with a justified budget when additional work is warranted; never edit the receipt downward.
controls.limitation: Cost is conservative when the host provides tokens but not a billed total, and unsupported runtimes must provide all five dimensions explicitly.

controls.title: Exact repeated-tool-cycle stop
controls.guarantee: The runtime blocks the call that would complete a third identical one-to-four-step tool cycle and stores only bounded signatures.
controls.failureMode: Fail the lane, stop the delivery, and deny the repeated call before execution.
controls.operatorAction: Inspect the loop record and create a materially changed plan rather than replaying the same sequence.
controls.limitation: Semantically repetitive work with changing tool names or inputs is not classified as an exact cycle.

controls.title: One auditable retry
controls.guarantee: Only the main thread may request one fresh atomic claim after a distinct failure; a second distinct failure stops the delivery.
controls.failureMode: Requeue once with stale evidence invalidated, then fail the stage and stop delivery on exhaustion.
controls.operatorAction: Review the typed failure and approve a new delivery if the exhausted work should continue under a new scope.
controls.limitation: The retry classifier relies on the main thread to describe the failure source and reason accurately.

controls.title: Durable interrupted-claim recovery
controls.guarantee: A confirmed orphaned claim freezes at its last observed activity and requires a main-thread continue or stop resolution before reclaim.
controls.failureMode: Keep the lane interrupted and unavailable until a valid resolution is recorded.
controls.operatorAction: Confirm the prior process no longer owns the claim, inspect partial outputs, then choose continue or stop.
controls.limitation: The kernel cannot independently prove that an external process died or reconstruct completion telemetry it never received.

controls.title: Ownership-derived PR and CI routing
controls.guarantee: CI failures route by exact declared check and review comments by longest owned-path match; unmatched events block dispatch.
controls.failureMode: Persist route_required and block new dispatch, or reject a caller-asserted wrong owner without recording it.
controls.operatorAction: Assign an unmatched event from the main thread after confirming the responsible stage.
controls.limitation: External polling and event delivery remain host responsibilities; the kernel can route only feedback it receives.

controls.title: Canonical lifecycle instructions
controls.guarantee: The shared lifecycle text is authored once and materialized byte-for-byte into all registered command and coordinator carriers.
controls.failureMode: Fail synchronization or CI when a carrier is stale, missing, duplicated, or structurally corrupt.
controls.operatorAction: Edit the canonical source, regenerate carriers, and review the generated diff rather than patching one carrier.
controls.limitation: Synchronized prompt text guides agents but does not replace runtime checks for protected transitions.

controls.title: Versioned attack matrix
controls.guarantee: Known malformed, replayed, concurrent, stale, and filesystem-indirected attacks assert their exact safe post-state in a release-required suite.
controls.failureMode: Fail hosted CI and prevent immutable release publication for the exact commit.
controls.operatorAction: Add a stable attack ID and regression before accepting a newly discovered bypass as fixed.
controls.limitation: The committed matrix covers named threat families and is not a proof against unknown attacks or same-account arbitrary code execution.

controls.title: Correlated delivery event integrity
controls.guarantee: Every persisted delivery mutation emits a typed, monotonic, hash-chained event and deterministic derived views without raw payloads.
controls.failureMode: Report unhealthy, refuse authoritative-chain growth, and block dispatch or closure until integrity is restored.
controls.operatorAction: Repair derived views only from a healthy authoritative chain; restore invalid kernel state from a known-good checkpoint.
controls.limitation: The hash chain detects accidental or partial tampering but is not a signature against deliberate same-account rewriting.

controls.title: Read-only outcome benchmark
controls.guarantee: A declared performance outcome cannot complete without a passing, source-bound receipt that compares repeated baseline and candidate runs and proves behavioral equivalence.
controls.failureMode: Reject malformed, mutating, behavior-changing, non-improving, tampered, or source-drifted evidence and leave the criterion unverified.
controls.operatorAction: Select a production-representative dataset, collect read-only captures with complete instrumentation, and review the receipt before accepting the outcome.
controls.limitation: The harness validates capture structure, repeated aggregates, hashes, and thresholds; it cannot prove that producer instrumentation saw every query or that the chosen dataset represents production.

controls.title: Guarded Laravel benchmark capture
controls.guarantee: The Laravel adapter rejects non-read-only SQL before execution, refuses unsafe environments and paths, and emits only stable hashes and aggregate measurements in comparator-compatible captures.
controls.failureMode: Exit unsuccessfully and leave no new capture when SQL, environment, path, database state, behavior stability, or schema checks fail.
controls.operatorAction: Use a read-only credential and representative disposable data, implement a minimal scenario fingerprint, and preserve failed evidence for diagnosis.
controls.limitation: The adapter cannot prove that database functions are side-effect-free, observe external-system mutations, or decide whether an application-defined fingerprint and dataset are representative.

controls.title: Bounded source-bound context packets
controls.guarantee: A built stage packet preserves mandatory kernel authority, admits only explicit repository-local excerpts as untrusted data, stays within its declared token budget, and fails verification after source or state drift.
controls.failureMode: Refuse construction or verification and stop dispatch when mandatory context does not fit, an input is unsafe, integrity fails, or authoritative state is stale.
controls.operatorAction: Select narrow relevant line ranges, review omissions, rebuild after legitimate state changes, and give only the verified stage packet to the named specialist.
controls.limitation: The runtime cannot prove that every supported host passed the packet to the agent, detect every possible secret format, or defend against a same-account process rewriting code and hashes together.

controls.title: Approval-gated durable memory retrieval
controls.guarantee: Only approved, unexpired, scope-matching, evidence-current memories enter a bounded context packet; conflicting facts require explicit supersession and deletion requires a separately approved tombstone transition.
controls.failureMode: Exclude stale, expired, irrelevant, unapproved, or wrong-scope memory; reject tampering, unresolved conflicts, unauthorized approval, mandatory-memory overflow, and unapproved deletion.
controls.operatorAction: Review candidate provenance and wording, approve from the main thread, supersede rather than overwrite conflicts, and approve a deletion request only after confirming the audit tombstone is appropriate.
controls.limitation: Hash chains detect partial or accidental changes but are not signatures against same-account rewriting; lexical retrieval may miss semantically relevant wording, and a human can still approve a poor memory.

controls.title: Source-bound agent evaluation receipts
controls.guarantee: Every registered live-agent case declares required and forbidden outcomes, deterministic checks remain authoritative, all four operational metrics are sealed with source hashes, and a material candidate regression exits unsuccessfully.
controls.failureMode: Reject malformed, stale, incomplete, tampered, source-drifted, wrong-case, failing, or materially regressed evidence without allowing an advisory judge to change the verdict.
controls.operatorAction: Authorize only the representative billed cases affected by a change, retain their derived receipts, compare candidate to an accepted same-definition baseline, and investigate every reported regression before release.
controls.limitation: CI validates the evaluator and recorded fixtures without spending model credits; live-agent outcomes remain stochastic and billed, source hashes are not signatures against same-account rewriting, and case selection remains an operator judgment.

controls.title: Exact-commit release publication
controls.guarantee: A stable release requires synchronized artifacts, a clean main commit, every named CI job green, an annotated immutable tag, and a retained receipt.
controls.failureMode: Refuse publication or a conflicting rerun without force, deletion, or tag replacement.
controls.operatorAction: Dispatch the manual workflow with the exact version and canonical title after hosted CI succeeds.
controls.limitation: Repository administrators and hosting-provider controls remain outside the publisher's threat boundary.
